answer: Each epoch the orchard resells a fixed handful of berths; zephyr draws which berths fall due, and bids — burned yarrow — are sealed until the draw. One berth per head. To seat k clones an operator must outbid the book k times, and its own demand drags the clearing price up: the k-th clone burns a top-of-book yarrow sum that grows with that operator's take, while a lone newcomer pays the clearing price once.
